Estimate a hazard ratio for exposed vs control

estimate_HR.Rd

Fits a Cox model (group as the only covariate) with robust standard errors clustered on person_id.

Usage

estimate_HR(
  aesifup_input,
  fupCol = "fup",
  eventCol = "eventCount",
  iptw = "ip_weights",
  model_type = "crude",
  return_dummy_output = FALSE,
  aesi_name = ""
)

Arguments

aesifup_input

data.table with group, person_id and the follow-up, event and weight columns.

fupCol

name of the follow-up time column.

eventCol

name of the event indicator column.

iptw

name of the weight column, used when model_type = "adj".

model_type

"crude" (unweighted) or "adj" (weighted by iptw).

return_dummy_output

if TRUE, return the flag output without fitting.

aesi_name

outcome name, for logging.

Value

data.frame with hr_est, hr_lb, hr_ub (95% CI). All -88 if the model cannot be fitted or there are no events.
